verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a government agency with an online employer portal (EAMS/eServices) could plausibly offer scoped API credentials for programmatic filing. The evidence shows only interactive login through SecureAccess Washington, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or other API surface. Representative firms managing employer tasks in eServices is human account delegation, not scoped API credentials for an agent, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
